complaint_money.name: from_bank_wallet_sim
complaint_money.label: Which bank, wallet or app did the money leave?
complaint_money.help: The one that sent the money, not the one that received it.

complaint_money.name: from_account_last4_sim
complaint_money.label: Last 4 digits of that account
complaint_money.help: Only the last four. Never the full number.

complaint_money.name: card_last4_sim
complaint_money.label: Last 4 digits of the card
complaint_money.help: Only if a card was used.

complaint_money.name: noticed_at
complaint_money.label: When did you notice?
complaint_money.help: Different from when it happened, and both are useful.

financial_transaction.name: amount_inr
financial_transaction.label: How much left your account?
financial_transaction.help: If there were several payments, add each one — the total is what matters.

financial_transaction.name: txn_id_utr_sim
financial_transaction.label: Transaction ID or UTR
financial_transaction.help: Usually 12 digits. The one number a bank uses to find the money. Leave blank if you cannot find it.

financial_transaction.name: to_identifier_sim
financial_transaction.label: Where did it go?
financial_transaction.help: A UPI ID, account number, merchant name or wallet address, if you have it.

financial_transaction.name: to_identifier_kind
financial_transaction.label: What kind of destination was that?

communication_event.name: still_ongoing
communication_event.label: Are they contacting you right now?
communication_event.help: Answer this first. It changes what we show you next.

communication_event.name: direction
communication_event.label: Who contacted whom?
communication_event.help: If you called a number you found online, say so — that number is the lead.

communication_event.name: duration_sec
communication_event.label: Roughly how long did it last, in minutes?

communication_event.name: content_text
communication_event.label: What did they say?
communication_event.help: Paste the message if you still have it.

online_identity.name: role
online_identity.label: What is this account?
options: An account pretending to be me

online_identity.name: asset_description
online_identity.label: What was taken?
online_identity.help: Items, currency, followers, anything of value.

online_identity.name: asset_value_inr
online_identity.label: Roughly what was it worth in rupees?
online_identity.help: Give a figure even if you are guessing. Without one, this gets treated as trivial.

web_artifact.name: is_public
web_artifact.label: Can anyone see it, or only certain people?

web_artifact.name: received_via
web_artifact.label: How did it reach you?
web_artifact.help: SMS, WhatsApp, email, a search result, a group.

web_artifact.name: what_it_asked_for
web_artifact.label: What did it ask you to do?
web_artifact.help: Log in, pay, scan, install, share a code.

web_artifact.name: credentials_entered
web_artifact.label: Did you enter anything on it?
web_artifact.help: A password, a PIN, an OTP, card details.

web_artifact.name: depicts_victim
web_artifact.label: Does it show or name the person affected?

web_artifact.name: first_seen_at
web_artifact.label: When did you first see it?

threat_record.name: threat_type
threat_record.label: What are they threatening to do?

threat_record.name: deadline_at
threat_record.label: Did they give you a deadline?
threat_record.help: If there is one, this moves to the front of the queue.

threat_record.name: contacted_known_contacts
threat_record.label: Have they contacted people you know?

attachment.name: files
attachment.label: Screenshots, photos, recordings or documents
attachment.help: A screenshot of the message, a photo of the receipt, a recording of the call, a screen recording, a bank statement. Any type, any size — attach as many as you like.

attachment.name: what_it_shows
attachment.label: What do these show?
attachment.help: One line is enough. It saves the officer opening every file to find out.

location.name: current_pincode
location.label: PIN code where you are staying now
location.help: This decides which cyber crime unit receives your report. If you are away from your registered address — studying, working, travelling — put where you actually are.

device_event.name: attacker_still_has_access
device_event.label: Do they still have access?
device_event.help: If you are not sure, say no and we will treat it as ongoing anyway.
